The structure of Mg2Si8Cr4 (Mg(Si2Cr)2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. The neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component containing all 14 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Mg and Si 9-vertex polyhedra, as well as corner- and face-sharing between Cr 10-vertex polyhedra.
